vertical_reference: LN02 / EPSG:5728; inspect per-asset header metadata

buffer_policy.selection: Tiles intersecting the canton or a conservative L-infinity expansion; includes every tile intersecting the Euclidean buffer
buffer_policy.height_and_low_sun_policy: 250m is a planning envelope, not a verified city maximum. T8/T10 must account for terrain relief along rays as well as object height; extend coverage or mark unknown when actual ray reach exceeds available geometry. Below 10 degrees, mark unsupported/unknown; night is a separate state.
buffer_policy.missing_buffer_policy: Receiver cells whose sunward ray reaches absent or NoData geometry remain unknown

storage_estimate.scope: Excludes metadata, temporary files and derived grids

batch_policy.order: Representative scenes, remaining receivers, then buffer assets
batch_policy.resume: Skip only checksum-verified and cell-validated local outputs
